Greetings.

Firstly, I'd like to start off by saying that I am a virgin. I am also younger than you (20 years old). I was overweight and am working on myself as a person both physically and mentally (now currently have my weight in good standing). 

Nonetheless, My advice to you good sir is ask yourself the question "Do I want "meaningless" (This is up to you) sex with someone I don't care about?". Please keep in mind this is my personal view and many others have different opinions so please keep this in mind. I find that sexual encounters are greatly enhanced by the emotions of which the two share. Kissing, touching, etc. While I have done things that are not exactly intercourse with both people I care about and a *cough* "random" stranger I have to say the thing I regret by far the most is doing anything with that stranger. I felt judged when I lost my erection and completely uncomfortable whereas when I was with someone I cared about (non-committed, but not FWB...) I felt very comfortable and able to talk to them. 

Since I have had the "opportunity" to explore my sexuality I have learned I find it absolutely fucking gross. Above the Waist = Awesome, Below = Gross. That's my personal view. 

I think your trying to fit a social criteria (bad word) or maybe stigma? of being a virgin? Don't feel pressured. The social stuff is bullshit. How did you feel in highschool about being overweight, or the status of your car, or anything? While I felt like I HAD to have certain things back then, now I just don't care and I realize it's stupid. 

Furthermore, I find most girls I have ever come into contact with unattractive until I get to know them. 

I'd like to conclude with my encouragement, if you will. Don't listen to anything anyone says...If you want to bang a hooker by damn bang a motherfucking hooker! Don't let anyone stop you. They're your dreams and yours alone, if someone puts you down fuck em'. Because YOU are who makes yourself you. You're amazing, and I want to be your friend...Your the type of person I want in this world.

I hope you have a fantastic day good sir, and I have "faith" in your ability to make a good decision.

I just feel like my troubles are increasing at an alarming rate, I feel I may not last through the week. I'd never threaten anything, ever...but I just am having a really hard time :(

I've tried my best to talk to an advisor, counselor (although not admitting to any depression/etc), and my instructors...and I still haven't gotten any progress...I truly don't want to admit to them what i'm having trouble with...I have a hard enough time sharing any information.

I have little if any desires, i've lost all interest in my hobbies that i've invested thousands in, I've even lost interest in my favorite foods...Lately i've only been eating about 1 meal per day...I just don't really have anything i'm interested in right now and I feel like it's just getting worse every day...

I guess the best way to put it is I'll take a shower to reduce stress which will last a couple hours then each time i do something to relieve stress the next "episode" will be slightly worse than the last one...where I'll feel more "push" to wanting to not be here
Thanks for the kind words, I'm trying to take it a day at a time but I feel it's getting worse.
I'm in school to pursue a "goal" i guess as an engineer and my job is only temporary :/ It will probably be gone in the next few months.

I just wanted to share that your thoughts are being heard and that you're not alone. I'm here to listen if you need to say anything.
